text:
Liam: Heads up — thinking of offering my RB (small flex) for Priya's WR in our office fantasy. Anyone care to veto? :eyes:
Priya: wait which RB? not my best WR pls. who are you sending exactly?
Liam: sending Darren (bench) + a future 2nd if needed. would free up a starting WR spot for me.
Priya: hmm Darren + a 2nd for Hill sounds fair but i'm worried about bye weeks.
Chen: quick spreadsheet sanity check: Liam9s RBs = [Darren, K. Mitchell], Priya's WRs = [Hill, Adams]. Trade parity seems ok.
Rosa: love the chaos. can we have a 24h veto window like last time?
opsbot: Trade submitted: Liam -> Priya (Darren + 2026 2nd-round pick for T. Hill). League rule: 24h veto window started.
Liam: posting a screenshot of my lineup to justify it: `START: Hill, Diggs, Jefferson`
Priya: counter-offer: Darren + 3rd-rounder? not keen on losing Hill.
Liam: i can add a swap: Darren + 3rd + waiver priority bump to Priya?
Chen: waiver priority bump is tempting, Priya. you'd climb from 5 to 3.
Rosa: also reminder: watch party tonight for the late game at 8pm in the break room. snacks welcome.
Priya: ok i'm leaning yes if bump included. also i'll bring buffalo wings. :hot_pepper:
Liam: wings = automatic approval from me. :laughing:
surveybot: POLL: Approve trade? Options: Approve, Veto
Chen: voted Approve
Rosa: voted Approve + will bring drinks
Priya: voted Approve (accepting bump)
Liam: voted Approve (duh)
opsbot: NOTE: 2 votes to veto needed. Current vetoes: 0.
Liam: low-key nervous about Priya benching Hill against me later. friendly reminder to set lineups.
Priya: i'll bench him only if he tanks. otherwise revenge is real. :smirk:
Chen: also plucked a pickup from waivers this morning: streaming kicker for the week, who needs a kicker like this?
Rosa: haha classic. see you all at 8. bring a jersey if you're dramatic.
Liam: final: trade accepted by league (no veto). congrats and sorrow, Priya. :trophy: :broken_heart:
